_comment: What the generic driver test needs to know about THIS algorithm.
tests/drive_and_compare.js checks properties any cascade should have --
that a driven run reproduces the recorded one, that a free choice changes
the work and not the answer, that the comparison can fail. None of that
needs to know what the algorithm computes. These three things do.
headline: what the answer should be, whatever any choice rule does.
operation: the step whose output counts as work done, and the tensor it
writes. Used to show the work varies across choices -- if it never
varied, the selector would not be reaching the cascade.
faults: anchors for the self-test, which breaks the run on purpose and
requires the comparison to notice. Two labels to swap, and a label
whose lowered case arms can be truncated.
